module

public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Erdős Problem 587

*Reference:* [erdosproblems.com/587](https://www.erdosproblems.com/587)
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Erdos587

/--
`MaxNotSqSum N` is the size of the largest subset `A` of
`{1,...,N}` such that for all non-empty `S ⊆ A`, the sum
`∑ n ∈ S, n` is not a square.
-/
def MaxNotSqSum (N : ℕ) : ℕ :=
    (Finset.Icc 1 N |>.powerset.filter fun A => ∀ S ⊆ A, S ≠ ⊥ →
      ¬ IsSquare (∑ n ∈ S, n)).sup Finset.card

/--
Nguyen and Vu proved that $|A| \ll N^{1/3} (\log N)^{O(1)}$.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 11]
theorem erdos_587.variants.nguyen_vu : ∃ᵉ (O > 0) (O' > 0),
    ∀ᶠ N in Filter.atTop, (MaxNotSqSum N : ℝ) ≤ O' * Real.nthRoot 3 N * (N : ℝ).log^O := by
  sorry

end Erdos587

reformulations.difference: The asymptotic bound is expressed using the extremal maximum, an explicit positive multiplicative constant, and a positive natural-number logarithmic exponent rather than an unspecified real exponent in O(1).
reformulations.equivalence_argument: The admissible family contains the empty set and its finite supremum is attained, so bounding MaxNotSqSum is equivalent to uniformly bounding every admissible A. For natural N, Real.nthRoot 3 N equals N^(1/3). Any fixed real logarithmic exponent c can be increased to a positive natural k, since log N ≥ 1 eventually; conversely a natural exponent is a real exponent. The complete equivalence with this source-style asymptotic bound was proved in /workspace/review/scratch.lean as Review587.full_upper_bound_equivalence, without using the sorry-backed theorem.

sources_consulted: Hoi H. Nguyen and Van H. Vu, Squares in sumsets, arXiv:0811.1311v2, Introduction (definition of S_A and SF(n), and the main upper-bound theorem). LaTeX source: https://arxiv.org/e-print/0811.1311
https://people.math.osu.edu/nguyen.1261/cikk-teljes.html — publication entry for Squares in sumsets
Local repository: FormalConjecturesForMathlib/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/NthRoot.lean; Mathlib definitions of IsSquare, Finset.powerset/filter/sup, Real.log, and Filter.atTop.
